answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, tied to one unique cipher-signed identity that cannot be duplicated without losing the stake. A fake clone must pay the full bond again, and if it misbehaves the stake is slashed, so mass Sybil creation becomes expensive rather than free. Honest agents keep a shared haven of verified peers, while an isolated island of unbonded newcomers gets limited trust until they prove history.
